official_measurement_examples.name: Smoke-control area rule
official_measurement_examples.fact: GOV.UK states that in smoke control areas smoke must not be emitted from chimneys and unauthorised fuel can only be used in an exempt appliance, subject to the statutory rules.

official_measurement_examples.name: Indicative national map caveat
official_measurement_examples.fact: Defra UK Air states its smoke-control-area map is indicative and users should contact the local authority to confirm whether a location is within an area.

official_measurement_examples.name: Civil penalty ceiling
official_measurement_examples.fact: GOV.UK states chimney smoke in an English smoke control area can lead to a local-authority penalty of up to £300 under the current civil enforcement regime.

official_measurement_examples.name: Fuel-sale offence
official_measurement_examples.fact: GOV.UK states unauthorised fuel supplied for inappropriate use in a smoke control area can attract fines, separate from planning control.

official_measurement_examples.name: Ready to Burn moisture threshold
official_measurement_examples.fact: Defra guidance states wood sold in volumes below 2 cubic metres must generally be certified Ready to Burn and have moisture content of 20 percent or less.

official_measurement_examples.name: Manufactured fuel authorisation test
official_measurement_examples.fact: Fuel-authorisation guidance states manufactured fuels for smoke-control use must meet smoke-emission and sulphur criteria before authorisation.

official_measurement_examples.name: Separate England-wide solid-fuel rules
official_measurement_examples.fact: Domestic solid-fuel sales rules apply across England and are separate from smoke-control-area restrictions.

official_measurement_examples.name: Authorised-fuels statutory list
official_measurement_examples.fact: The Defra smoke-control system publishes the authorised fuels list for England, but inclusion of a fuel does not determine whether any particular development or appliance installation has planning permission.
